description: Finds the exact import chain that connects a changed source file to a test file. Use to answer: why does changing file X cause test Y to be affected? Returns the step-by-step import path from the test to the changed file.

changed_file.description: The source file that was changed (absolute or relative to project_root)

project_root.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript project root (must contain tsconfig.json)

test_file.description: The test file to explain the connection for

name: explain_impact
